title: SharePoint: Page Agent creates and refines SharePoint pages from Copilot chat
summary: The roadmap details and the documented Block path and Graph call check out. However, the briefing incorrectly says Block is the only documented agent control; its own cited Microsoft page also documents uninstalling and deleting agents. Narrow that statement without implying those other actions apply to the Page Agent.
